script_text:
A Friday conversation could transform Pisces’ love life and finances.

Neptune, your water-sign ruler, favors listening, but Monday favors a raise or client fee: Mercury in your 10th House sextiles Saturn in your 1st. Mercury stays retrograde, so keep salary requests measured and in writing. Wednesday’s Sun in your 9th squares the Moon in your 1st, so protect your energy instead of answering everyone.

Friday’s Pisces full Moon in your 3rd sextiles Pluto in your 11th, shifting romantic honesty and shared-money negotiations into the spotlight.

Saturday’s Sun trines Mars in your 12th, giving romance momentum and helping a tedious cash review.

Friday is your power day because the full Moon illuminates your 3rd House of communication.

Sunday is your warning day because the Sun squares Uranus in your 9th, risking travel delays and costly mistakes.

Write one clear message before Friday.

Follow for daily updates.
